title: Valid Login
description: Attempt login with valid credentials.
expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Invalid Password Rejection
description: Attempt login with incorrect password.
expected_result: System displays error message and denies access.

title: Account Lockout After Failed Attempts
description: Attempt login with wrong password 5 consecutive times.
expected_result: Account is locked and administrator is notified.

title: Admin Role Access
description: Log in as Admin and verify access to all modules.
expected_result: All modules are accessible to Admin role.

title: Viewer Role Restriction
description: Log in as Viewer and attempt to create a deviation.
expected_result: System denies creation and displays permission error.

title: Audit Entry on Deviation Create
description: Create a new deviation and verify audit log entry.
expected_result: Audit log contains actor timestamp action and record ID.

title: Audit Entry on Status Change
description: Change deviation status and verify audit trail update.
expected_result: Audit log reflects before and after status with actor.

title: Audit Log Immutability
description: Attempt to modify an existing audit log entry via API.
expected_result: System returns 405 Method Not Allowed; no record is altered.

title: Create Deviation Record
description: Submit a valid deviation with all required fields.
expected_result: Deviation is created with status Open and system-generated timestamp.

title: Missing Required Field Rejection
description: Submit a deviation without the severity field.
expected_result: System returns 422 Unprocessable Entity with field error detail.

title: Status Transition Open to Under Investigation
description: Transition a deviation from Open to Under Investigation.
expected_result: Status updates and audit event is appended.

title: Invalid Status Transition
description: Attempt to transition a Resolved deviation back to Open.
expected_result: System returns 400 Bad Request with transition rule explanation.

title: CSV Batch Import Valid File
description: Upload a well-formed CSV with 10 deviation records.
expected_result: All 10 records are imported; summary report returned.

title: CSV Import Duplicate Detection
description: Upload a CSV containing 3 records already in the system.
expected_result: Duplicates are flagged and skipped; 0 duplicate records imported.

title: Risk Score High Threshold
description: Create a critical overdue deviation with recurrence flag.
expected_result: Risk score is >= 5 and classified as High.

title: Risk Score Low Threshold
description: Create a minor on-time deviation with no recurrence.
expected_result: Risk score is <= 1 and classified as Low.

title: CSV Export Completeness
description: Export all deviations as CSV and verify all columns are present.
expected_result: CSV contains all expected columns for every record.

title: Load Test — 100 Concurrent Users
description: Simulate 100 concurrent API requests during business hours.
expected_result: Response time <= 2 seconds for 95% of requests.

title: Backup File Exists
description: Verify backup file was created after scheduled backup job.
expected_result: Backup file present in target directory with correct timestamp.

title: Session Timeout Enforcement
description: Leave a session idle for 16 minutes and attempt an action.
expected_result: System terminates session and redirects to login page.

title: Electronic Signature on Closure
description: Close a deviation and verify e-signature prompt with reason.
expected_result: Closure requires actor confirmation and reason; appended to audit log.
